messages:
deploy-bot: initiating canary rollout release=v1.2.3 service=inference-router canary_pct=5 region=us-west-2 at 2026-03-15T02:12:12Z
jamal: kicking off canary, watching logs and latency charts
priya: seeing 5xx spike on canary fleet, +6.8% over baseline, routing still 5%
alex: paging on-call (pager duty)
incident-bot: @priya alerted for INC-20260315-KMS: elevated 5xx on inference-router (us-west-2)
priya: jumping in — pulling pod logs for canary replica set
priya: logs show repeated decrypt failures: "AccessDeniedException: arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/infra-canary-role is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/rotated-1234"
jamal: we rotated the master model key earlier; config maps set KMS_KEY_ARN via env var MODEL_KMS_KEY
emily: PR that changed key reference: https://github.com/redwood-inference/configs/pull/449 — seems correct, but maybe IAM not updated for canary role
priya: checking pod service account/role binding — canary pods assume infra-canary-role as expected
ops-jen: confirm infra-canary-role IAM policy currently allows kms:Decrypt on previous key only (key/old-5678)
alex: so new key ARN is in config, but role not granted decrypt permission -> startup fails when service fetches model secret -> 502s for requests routed to canary
priya: immediate mitigation: flip routing feature-flag to stop sending traffic to canaries
jamal: flag name is feature.edge_routing.new_path (LaunchDarkly)
priya: executing emergency toggle:
```
ldctl toggle --env prod --flag feature.edge_routing.new_path --off --who priya --reason "emergency: KMS decrypt failures on canary"
```
deploy-bot: feature toggle applied. traffic now pinned to stable nodes
priya: error-rate back to baseline within 45s, 5xx count dropping :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: INC-20260315-KMS acknowledged by priya
mike-cs: CS noticed some customer errors in APAC during window 02:12-02:18 UTC, drafting customer note now
jamal: short-term: revert canary image to v1.2.2 on canary nodes and restore stable behavior; medium-term: patch infra-canary-role IAM policy to include new key ARN
ops-jen: initiating canary image rollback to v1.2.2:
```
kubectl -n inference rollout undo deploy/inference-router --to-revision=20260315-122
```
priya: pods coming back up with previous image, verifying no KMS AccessDenied errors
ops-jen: new pods healthy; metrics show no further decrypt errors
priya: monitoring for 10m window — stable
alex: opening follow-ups: INFRA-987: "KMS rotation -> ensure IAM role coverage for canary/service accounts" and ENG-2047: "deploy checklist: validate env KMS key and IAM bindings before canary"
emily: product note: will reduce window for automatic key rotation during deploys and add preflight checks to prevent drift
mike-cs: created CS ticket CS-8077 to notify affected customers and include incident id INC-20260315-KMS
priya: recommended permanent fixes: 1) CI gating step that calls iam:SimulatePrincipalPolicy or validates role has kms:Decrypt on new key, 2) ensure config -> infra change approvals include IAM policy changes, 3) add Canary preflight that verifies decryption at pod start
jamal: also adding an Ops automation to detect key ARN vs role policy mismatch and alert pre-deploy
ops-jen: will disable automatic canary pushes until ENG-2047 merged and validated
incident-bot: INC-20260315-KMS marked stabilized; postmortem required
alex: timeline for notes: - 02:12 canary start - 02:14 decrypt errors & 5xx rise - 02:15 feature flag kill -> stop routing - 02:16 rollback to v1.2.2 - 02:18 error rates normalized - 02:45 triage call scheduled
priya: handing off to alex for post-incident write-up, I'm out in ~25m for scheduled time off
alex: taking ownership for postmortem + coordinating INFRA-987 and ENG-2047; will attach logs, deploy diffs, IAM policy snippets to the postmortem doc
mike-cs: customer note drafted, will wait for postmortem link
incident-bot: INC-20260315-KMS transitioned to RESOLVED by alex at 2026-03-15T03:10:00Z
alex: closing thread, postmortem link will be posted to #incidents and to the incident tracker
